items.title: Ray Bauduc Interview, 1984-06-27
items.q: Joe Wolf, he left the band and went back to New Orleans.

ctx.x: Mm-hmm . Well, we got this guy to play clarinet with us. See, some of the guys got homesick and left the band. That was the second time we played in the Tokyo Garden, see, and left the band. Joe Wolf, he left the band and went back to New Orleans. Charlie Horton went back to New Orleans. So we had a lefty with us, lefty stayed with us, and Bouchon stayed with us. Baquet was all settled out there and different club dates and so forth out there. So he stayed out in California, see. But I thought you were talking…
And you said that's when Benny Goodman left which band that Matty came in?
